name: MonoBar
author: wynout
description: Choose which monitors carry the Omarchy bar — one, several, or all. Selected screens get the bar while connected; with none connected the native bar-on-every-screen behavior applies. Inherits the native bar — widgets, layout, theming and popouts stay Omarchy-owned. Ships with a picker widget that lives in the bar.

barWidget.description: Pick the screens that carry the bar
